sources.provider: Purdue University GIS / ArcGIS REST feature service
sources.method: Transformed source polygon coordinates from WGS84 into the project local tangent approximation: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274 degrees); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0. Used the 10 unique ring vertices; retained the non-rectangular east-side projection.

computed_outline.orientation: long axis approximately north-south; polygon edge bearing differs from cardinal axis by about 0.4 degrees

sources.uncertainty: ArcGIS metadata does not document units for Extrution or the shape summary fields. The polygon is the measured input; 24 was interpreted as feet only to guide an approximately 7.3 m total-height estimate. The service geometry is map data, not a survey certificate.

sources.provider: Purdue University Office of Emergency Preparedness
sources.crs: Not applicable; official building description and program source.
facts_used: The facility is an administrative building with two floors, mostly cubicle workspace.
The main entry and AED are on the east wall.
The first-floor restrooms used for shelter are at the southwest corner.
The second floor contains Utility Engineering and BAS staff.
sources.uncertainty: The emergency plan is not an architectural elevation or complete floor plan; interior partition geometry is schematic and not to scale.

sources.provider: Esri World Imagery (basemap tile service; imagery contributors vary by area)
sources.tile_crs: Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere, WKID 102100 / EPSG:3857
sources.imagery_acquisition_date: Not reported for this tile by the basemap endpoint.
visual_observations_used: The roof is bright/light-valued and shows repeated narrow seams or ribs.
A few small tonal breaks are visible but their identity as equipment is uncertain; the low, flat-looking roof silhouette is clearer.
The footprint form includes a main rectangular mass and an east-side projection.
sources.uncertainty: Overhead imagery supports roof texture and footprint/context, but cannot establish facade materials, window positions, exact roof pitch, or height.

sources.provider: Esri World Imagery (basemap tile service; imagery contributors vary by area)
sources.tile_crs: Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere, WKID 102100 / EPSG:3857
sources.imagery_acquisition_date: Not reported for this tile by the basemap endpoint.
sources.method: Assembled the four native 256×256 tiles without resampling; the source GIS feature ring was projected to tile pixels and drawn as a magenta outline for visual footprint comparison.
visual_observations_used: The source outline aligns with a bright, nearly continuous main roof and an east-side projection.
Roof seams run approximately east-west in the north-up image.
The roof image does not substantiate four raised HVAC cabinets or an access hatch, so none are included in the revised model.
sources.uncertainty: The acquisition date is not reported; shadows and low-resolution roof details can obscure small features.

sources.provider: Purdue University Engineering Computer Network (ECN) webcam gallery
sources.crs: Not georeferenced; oblique fixed webcam view.
sources.visual_observations: The camera is labeled 'from UPOF' and shows Wade Utility Plant context. A close wall in frame has pale gray vertically ribbed cladding, a horizontal divider, a lower masonry-looking section, and small windows/service doors.
sources.use_and_uncertainty: Context only: exact camera bearing and the identity of the close wall are not documented, so its cladding was not treated as a direct verified UPOF elevation. It supports only a restrained light-gray industrial facade treatment; facade window positions remain estimates.

sources.role: Context only. The nearest panorama is northeast of UPOF and does not provide a direct facade view of UPOF; it was not used to infer facade details.
